newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani prime minister expands cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani prime minister expands cabinet.

text.p: Pakistan's Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif expanded his cabinet on Friday, inducting nine new ministers and four deputy ministers of state, the official APP news agency said.
President Farooq Leghari swore in the new members of the cabinet, which previously had seven ministers and two advisers to the prime minister with ministerial status.

The new ministers are Raja Zafarul Haq, Sheikh Rashid Ahmed, Raja Nadir Pervez, Sardar Yaqub Khan, Makhdoom Javed Hashemi, Ghous Ali Shah, Yasin Wattoo, Majid Malik and Abdul Sattar Laleka and the ministers of state Tahmina Daultana, Mohammad Siddiq Kanju, Halim Siddiqui and Makhdoom Ahmad Mahmood.
Their portfolios were not immediately announced.
Sharif had formed his cabinet last February after his Pakistan Muslim League party won a landslide victory in general elections.
